evidence_scope: Contract manifest only. No Windows adapter source exists on the evidence baseline.

memory.evidence: A user-controlled local memory adapter is specified but not implemented.

voice.evidence: Offline voice and barge-in are specified but not implemented.

avatar.evidence: Software and supported GPU rendering paths are specified but not implemented.

device.evidence: Only public user-authorized Windows capabilities will be exposed; no adapter exists.

notification.evidence: Windows notification support is specified but not implemented.

storage.evidence: User-scoped local storage is specified but not implemented.

process.evidence: Fixed allowlisted process operations through the single control plane are specified but not implemented.

network.evidence: Explicit opt-in network support is specified but not implemented.

presentation.evidence: Windowed, tray, always-on-top, and supported background modes are specified but not implemented.
